script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmos just threw a lightning bolt at your doorstep. Mars, your ruling planet, is conjunct Saturn at fifteen degrees in your 1st House, demanding you own every reckless impulse before it costs you. Venus in Taurus is squaring this conjunction from your 4th House of Home, stirring up old resentments with someone you live with or your family. If you're single, a bold but guarded approach to someone new could ignite something real—just don't rush the commitment. In your 10th House of Career, this Mars-Saturn squeeze tightens deadlines and forces a decision you've been avoiding; say yes to the opportunity that scares you. The blessing hiding in this tension: unexpected clarity about a financial matter by evening. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
